summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K to report its monthly net asset value per share as of June 30, 2026. The filing provides a breakdown of total NAV ($647 million) and NAV per class, calculated per board-approved valuation guidelines. This is a routine periodic update with no M&A, corporate action, or other special situation event. The disclosure includes property appraisals and asset valuations but does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring. Accordingly, this filing does not meet the criteria for a special situation category.
